messages:
pat: FYI we received the pentest package this AM. Critical: broad service-account binding enabling lateral RBAC escalation; KMS audit sampling disabled on one keyring; and a gap in service-to-service auth logs. Need a short remediation + sealed evidence run and vendor retest slot. Who volunteers for RBAC, KMS, evidence?

erin: I can do the RBAC remediation. Plan is minimal change: create `infra.limited` custom role, canary attach to svc-infra-canary, monitor 20m, then roll. Will capture pre/post IAM snapshots.

marco: I'll own KMS artifact collection. We have both GCP KMS and AWS CMEK. I'll export Cloud Audit/CloudTrail slices + describe-key outputs and ensure no key rotations during capture.

isabel: I'll handle evidence packaging and signatures. I'll provision a read-only, versioned bucket `gs://pt-evidence-4372` with retention and upload sealed artifacts + README_FOR_VENDOR.md.

oncall: Standby for the window. Rollback if any control-plane regressions: reapply `pre-iam.$TS.json` or restore terraform state. Page SRE immediately if we see control-plane errors.

pat: Suggested window: Mon 2024-09-30 13:00 UTC, duration 75m. Sequence: pre-snapshots -> apply RBAC canary -> monitor -> collect KMS + service logs -> seal uploads -> provide signed manifest -> vendor retest booking.

erin: Snapshot commands I'll run: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json > pre-iam.$TS.json` and post-change `> post-iam.$TS.json`. Terraform plan will be in a PR with `tf plan -out=plan.out`.

marco: KMS export examples: GCP: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com"' --freshness=30d --format=json > kms-gcp-30d.ndjson`; AWS: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-08-31 --end-time 2024-09-30 --query Events > kms-aws-30d.json`. I'll also `gcloud kms keys describe` and `aws kms describe-key` for metadata.

isabel: Packaging checklist: filename, sha256, capture command, operator, timestamp, GPG fingerprint. Example: `kms-gcp-30d.ndjson, <sha256>, gcloud logging read ..., marco, 2024-09-30T13:45:00Z, 0xDEADBEEF`. I'll `gpg --detach-sign` each artifact and store signatures.

pat: Compliance note: do NOT rotate or rewrap keys before artifacts are sealed. Marco confirm.

marco: Confirmed. No rotations until after sealed upload. If an emergency rotation is required, it will be logged and included in manifest.

erin: Canary plan: 1) create role `infra.limited` with minimal perms; 2) attach to `svc-infra-canary`; 3) monitor metrics and PERMISSION_DENIED counts for 20m; 4) if <5% deviation, roll to rest; else rollback. Rollback CLI: `gcloud projects set-iam-policy $PROJECT pre-iam.$TS.json`.

isabel: Evidence bucket config: uniform access, versioning ON, retention 30d, forcedOwner, and objects uploaded then ACLs removed. I'll compute checksums: `sha256sum file > file.sha256` and include capture commands in manifest.

oncall: I'll add short-lived alert: log-based metric watching `protoPayload.methodName:SetIamPolicy` and `PERMISSION_DENIED` spikes. If errors > baseline*1.05 for 10m -> auto rollback.

evidence-bot: Retest scheduler: vendor requested earliest slot after upload. Proposed retest: Mon 2024-09-30 16:00 UTC (2h). Blocked tentatively.

pat: Final owners: erin (RBAC PR + snapshots), marco (KMS exports + keymeta), isabel (evidence bucket + signatures + manifest), oncall (rollback + alerts), pat (vendor coordination). React with :white_check_mark: if you're set.

erin: :white_check_mark: PR ETA today EOD.

marco: :white_check_mark: starting keylist now.

isabel: :white_check_mark: will provision bucket and prepare signing key (0xDEADBEEF).

oncall: :white_check_mark: pager rotated.

pat: Thanks all. I'll lock the calendar invite and post the final manifest link in this thread after upload. Keep updates here during the window.
